headline: Oil Prices Fall More Than 1% on Expectations of Oversupply
summary: Oil prices fell more than 1% on Wednesday, erasing the previous day's gains, as expectations of a market surplus outweighed concerns about shipping disruptions in the Middle East.
why: Brent is the leading global crude benchmark, and its price influences fuel costs, inflation and the earnings of oil producers and refiners.
why_moved: Expectations of a market surplus outweighed concerns about Middle East shipping disruptions, reducing the previous day's gains.
original_headline: Precios del petróleo retroceden más de 1% ante expectativas de exceso de suministro
